## Language

## Type of problem
Missing translation, wrong translation, typo or inconsistent wording?
## Where is it?

Example: https://nat688.github.io/Cubesia/wiki.html#auction-house

Paste the text as it appears now.
## Proposed text
Optional. Server names (ranks, items, features) stay in English.
